notes.title: Bug Fix Update Notice September 4, 2025
notes.content:
[p]We have just implemented an update to fix bugs.
The main changes are as follows.

・Fixed an issue where the display would not return to normal when reading letters while using camera focus or fast walking.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where input would become invalid if certain actions were performed immediately after closing text displayed in specific locations.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where in-game displays would persist if returning to the title screen at specific timing.[/p][p]We deeply regret the trouble.[/p][p]Please continue to feel free to share any feedback, requests, or bug reports you may have.[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update Announcement July 2, 2025
notes.content: [p]We have recently implemented an update to correct several bugs. The main changes are as follows[/p][p][/p][p]1. Fixed a bug in which if a player stood motionless in the train for an extended period of time, the train vibration would cause the player's coordinates to gradually shift, causing the player to become stuck in a placed object, which interfered with progress.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Fixed unintended expressions related to weather settings, especially those related to falling objects such as rain and snow, as intended by the development team.[/p][p][/p][p]We are confident that you will enjoy a more pleasant gaming experience with this update.[/p]

notes.title: AMATA Games is the new publisher! Version upgrades will happen simultaneously!
notes.content:
“FARAWAY TRAIN” is an atmospheric narrative adventure game developed by the indie game studio Tatamibeya, acclaimed for their hit title “NOSTALGIC TRAIN.” Originally released in June 2021, the game captivates players with its stunning scenery and a compelling narrative exploring the fleeting life of the final Empress Roxelana, whose actions are tied to a world brought to ruin.

AMATA Games has now taken on publishing responsibilities for the Steam version of “FARAWAY TRAIN” aiming to bring this captivating experience to an even wider audience. Coinciding with this transition, a significant version update has been released, featuring the following enhancements:
- Added Steam Achievements feature 
- Adjusted in-game menu 
- Game controller support 
- Support for save data per account 
- Improved ePUB reader functionality 
- Added translated languages (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese) 
- Other adjustments

AMATA Games will be marketing the title globally as “FARAWAY TRAIN”.

Additionally, the game's retail price has been revised to 13.99 USD, offering greater accessibility to players.

notes.title: アップデートのお知らせ　6/16
notes.content:
アップデートのお知らせ

この度下記のプレイアビリティ向上および不具合修正を伴うアップデートを実施いたしました。
[list]
[*] フリーモードの読書中に景色も楽しんでいただけるよう、背景画面を半透明にするオプションの追加　（読書画面横の「設定」ボタンから）
[*] 中心点を常時表示するオプションの追加　（メニュー＞設定＞操作）
[*] 着座時に時間の経過で座標が徐々にずれることがある問題の修正
[*] アイテムの視認性の改善
[*] その他各種不具合の修正
[/list]

notes.title: バグ修正アップデートのお知らせ　6/8
notes.content:
バグ修正アップデートのお知らせ　6/8

先ほど、不具合を修正するアップデートを実施いたしました。
主な変更点は以下の通りです。

[list]
[*] 特定の条件・操作のもとでプレイを継続すると車両の座標にずれが生じてくる問題の修正
[*] 上記に起因する、プレイヤースポーン時の問題の修正
[*] 同じく上記に起因する、車両間の移動に不具合が生じていた問題の修正
[*] その他、文章表現など細かいバグの修正
[/list]

上記の不具合が発生してご迷惑をおかけしておりましたプレイヤー様には、こちらのアップデートで以前より快適に遊んでいただけるものと考えております。

notes.title: バグ修正アップデートのお知らせ　6/6
notes.content:
本日も各種不具合修正、安定化を含むアップデートを実施いたしました。

修正内容は
[list]
[*] プレイヤーの当たり判定の改善
[*] UI周りの挙動の改善
[*] 一部、非常に分かりにくかった鍵の位置の微調整
[*] その他種々のバグ修正
[/list]
となっております。

貴重な不具合ご報告、ご意見ありがとうございます。
引き続き継続的にアップデートしてまいりますので、何卒よろしくお願いいたします。

notes.title: バグ修正アップデートのお知らせ
notes.content:
